tests: typing begun 0.3 s after a file opens at a line is reordered by the re-reveal
the same typing begun 1 s after the file opens puts xyz at the start of the line in order
steps:
Measured by a script, not by hand: a person has to type without a pause of 0.7 s, which is hard to time.
1. Open typing-after-open-reversed.twinproj in the twinBASIC IDE, with Haystack.twin not open in an editor tab.
2. Open Haystack.twin at line 4, column 9 the way Find in Files does: in the page, openEditors.openFile(node, false, false, false, 4, 9), with node the file's entry in the project tree. By hand: Find in Files for "Dim needleCount" (one match, at line 4, column 9), and double-click the result.
3. 0.3 s later move the cursor to line 3, column 1, and type xyz, one key every 150 ms.
4. Expected: line 3 starts with xyz. Actual: line 3 starts with x, and line 4 reads "        zyDim needleCount As Long".
Control: the same typing started more than 0.7 s after the file opened puts xyz at 3:1 in order.
Asserted on BETA 997 by ide-test.bat --only typing-after-open, with the control.
